messages.text: Hello if i order from EU warehouse i still need to pay VAT ? in the shipping form there was the price without VAT and it wasnt added into the order

Short answer: checkout never collects import VAT, so a missing VAT line there doesn't tell you either way.

If the unit is held in our EU warehouse, import VAT is already in the price and nothing more is due on delivery. If it ships from the US or Canada warehouse, the listed price is the unit price and 21% import VAT plus any duty is charged by the carrier when it lands, we don't collect it and can't quote the exact figure.
